scenes.headline: Your lamp is *too bright*
scenes.say: [curious] Why does your living room feel like an office at night?

scenes.headline: Go warm: *2700 K* or lower
scenes.say: Swap cold white bulbs for warm ones, around twenty-seven hundred kelvin.

scenes.headline: Three lights, not one
scenes.say: Use three low lights instead of one bright ceiling lamp.

scenes.headline: Make evenings *slower*
scenes.say: [warmly] Find your lamp on our site.
